from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys

home=Path.home()
runtime=home/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
sys.path.insert(0,str(runtime))
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installed_bridge_e023",runtime/"bridge_server.py")
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp)
assert sp.loader is not None
sp.loader.exec_module(m)
base=m.base

assert getattr(m.Handler,"server_version","")=="PredictionChatWake/1.3-continuation-v2"
assert hasattr(base,"INFLIGHT")
assert hasattr(base,"ACK_HOOK")
assert base.ACK_HOOK is m.continuation_ack_hook

source_text=(runtime/"bridge_server_v2.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert 'INFLIGHT = DATA_DIR / "inflight"' in source_text
assert "os.replace(path, claimed)" in source_text
assert "inflight_src if inflight_src.exists() else outbox_src" in source_text

root=Path(os.environ["PRED_PROJECT_TEMP_ROOT"])/"native-ack-e023"
data=root/"bridge"
states=root/"states"
data.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
states.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

old_data=base.DATA_DIR
old_states=m.TASK_STATE_DIR
try:
    base.DATA_DIR=data
    m.TASK_STATE_DIR=states
    source="DEV-PRED-CONT-E023-SOURCE"
    (states/f"{source}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "schema":"PREDICTION_COMMAND_BUS_TASK_STATE_V1",
        "task_id":source,
        "status":"DISPATCHED",
        "auto_continue":True,
    }),encoding="utf-8")
    m.continuation_ack_hook(
        {"event_id":"e023-result","task_id":source,"source":"result"},
        chat_id="chat-e023-native",
        consumer_id="tab-e023-native",
        already_acked=False,
    )
    cid=m.continuation.ids_for(source)["continuation_id"]
    cp=m.continuation.continuation_path(data,cid)
    assert cp.is_file()
    rec=json.loads(cp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert rec["source_task_id"]==source
    assert rec["chat_id"]=="chat-e023-native"
finally:
    base.DATA_DIR=old_data
    m.TASK_STATE_DIR=old_states

print("NATIVE_ACK_INSTALL_E023=PASS")
print("INFLIGHT_NATIVE=PASS")
print("ACK_HOOK_BOUND=PASS")
print("SYNTHETIC_RESULT_ACK_CREATES_CONTINUATION=PASS")
